svg.title: Extract records and wait for events
svg.desc: watch uses DOM mutation and input/change/load events rather than repeated agent calls. It returns matched: false when its duration expires; durations are 0–25 seconds, with at most 16 watches per document. A programmatic value change that emits no observed event can be missed. Use ordinary wait --js when the condition needs polling or JavaScript computation. This is a one-result wait, not a durable event stream. General wait --js conditions react to DOM/input/load/visibility events too, retaining a 100 ms fallback for globals/time or unobserved changes. Predicates may run repeatedly; keep them free of side effects. Resources remain on demand and are removed on completion, cancellation, timeout or navigation.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
